facts.name: Wild Columbine
facts.notes: Dangling red-and-yellow flowers in spring that hummingbirds love. Short-lived but reseeds gently.

sources.note: Shear perennial salvia, coreopsis, Shasta daisy, columbine, coral bells, hardy geranium and catmint after flowering; many rebloom in 5 to 6 weeks.

companions.why: Combines well with hostas and astilbe in shade gardens, and with wild geranium and wild ginger in natural settings.
